description: AI Logic's 403 refusal, as captured on 2026-10-22 from a project whose enforcement mode read UNENFORCED, on firebase 12.13.0. This is not a capture of ENFORCED mode. Later re-captures of these observations ran on a project that answers 200, so the sandbox's refusal is pinned here. Copied unchanged from the observations at sourceCommit. Lives outside observations/ because the version guard requires those to name the installed SDK. See #1300.
